reviews.text:
Love the app, but..... This really is a wonderful app for those of us who have a hard time hearing clearly in church, but there is one issue I would ask you to consider addressing. 

As it is, the text is so small when the phone is held in portrait position that it is very difficult to read. Then, when we turn it to landscape mode, the ads take up so much space at the bottom of the screen that there is little room for the text of the readings. And they are a total distraction. I would gladly pay for an ad-free version of this app.

An alternative might be the ability to alter the font size in portrait mode to make it more readable. But I would still prefer not to have the ads running across the screen. 

Thank you for this otherwise wonderful Mass participation aid and thank you for considering my concerns.
